modes.cue_notes: From all fours, slide one arm under the other arm and through to the opposite side, lowering the shoulder and cheek to the floor. The hips remain elevated over the knees. The arm extending underneath creates the spinal rotation in the thoracic spine. The opposite arm can extend forward or press into the floor. Hold each side.

source: Traditional yin yoga; see Paul Grilley, Bernie Clark, Sarah Powers
notes: Targets the thoracic rotational fascia and posterior shoulder. Gallbladder meridian runs the lateral body; small intestine meridian runs the outer arm and shoulder blade region.
